incident_text: Portfolio updates are delayed for many users and the consumer looks busy but nothing seems to be getting through since about 09:00.

truth.description: A single malformed, undecodable message on portfolio-updates is repeatedly nacked and requeued by portfolio-consumer (a poison message), causing a redelivery loop that stalls consumption.
